text: Rejected as a description of THIS model. The permutation-of-token-3 rule fits the 64 dataset labels shown in E0001, but the loaded checkpoint agrees with those labels only at chance (0.203 in E0002, 0.200 in E0003), so it does not compute that rule or any function matching the labels. The rule remains an untested observation about the labels only.

STOP per protocol step 1: the model does not do the behaviour (accuracy at chance on two independent samples, n=128 and n=400, mean logit diff ~0 with std ~14). There is no mechanism to explain, so no circuit search, no predict() and no verify_hypothesis were run. 22 of 25 experiments unused. Reporting a null finding.
